title: Command Menu
lede: Launch a set of actions as a full-screen overlay.

examples.heading: Default
With divider
With suffix
Open
examples.description: The open command menu (a client-only state): the faded overlay, the 640px dialog at 15% from the top with its input block (the searchbox and the Esc chip) and the list of three groups; the first item is highlighted.
examples.code:
export function Component(): JSX.Element {
  return (
    <CommandMenu open setOpen={() => {}}>
      <CommandMenuInput placeholder="What do you need?" />
      <CommandMenuList>
        <CommandMenuGroup heading="Suggestions">
          <CommandMenuItem>Figma Import</CommandMenuItem>
        </CommandMenuGroup>
        <CommandMenuGroup heading="Commands">
          <CommandMenuItem>Import Extension</CommandMenuItem>
          <CommandMenuItem>Manage Extensions</CommandMenuItem>
        </CommandMenuGroup>
        <CommandMenuGroup heading="Collaboration">
          <CommandMenuItem>Flags Explorer</CommandMenuItem>
        </CommandMenuGroup>
      </CommandMenuList>
    </CommandMenu>
  );
}

children.text: Use the command menu to navigate through Vercel.

examples.heading: Open with divider
examples.description: The With divider example open: three loose items with a separator between the second and the third, then a group.
examples.code:
export function Component(): JSX.Element {
  return (
    <CommandMenu open setOpen={() => {}}>
      <CommandMenuInput placeholder="What do you need?" />
      <CommandMenuList>
        <CommandMenuItem>Item 1</CommandMenuItem>
        <CommandMenuItem>Item 2</CommandMenuItem>
        <CommandMenuDivider />
        <CommandMenuItem>Item 3</CommandMenuItem>
        <CommandMenuGroup heading="Group 1">
          <CommandMenuItem>Grouped Item 1</CommandMenuItem>
          <CommandMenuItem>Grouped Item 2</CommandMenuItem>
        </CommandMenuGroup>
      </CommandMenuList>
    </CommandMenu>
  );
}
